purpose: Document first-party discovery, current public land-record routes, bounded anonymous access review, scope limits, and uncertainty.
assessment: The official Survey Department MeroKitta portal exposes anonymous administrative and mapsheet metadata for the Morang/Biratnagar survey office. Its current JavaScript exposes public GET routes for office, district, local-level, ward, and mapsheet lookup. The tested routes returned no parcel geometry or parcel-ID response. The portal's service application requires landowner certificate/citizenship documents and submission, which was not attempted.
registryAssessment: Local custodian evidence is present: Survey Department's Morang office is listed for Biratnagar, and the Department of Land Management and Archive has a Biratnagar office. This does not prove an anonymous citywide cadastral vector registry, so registryFound is null.

remainingUncertainty: The official MeroKitta service may provide parcel map prints or other land records after document-backed service submission, and the Morang survey-office site may expose additional routes when available. Those flows are outside anonymous safe research because they require landowner documents, mobile/OTP or institutional access, and potentially personal or title data. The administrative/mapsheet responses do not establish citywide parcel coverage or absence.
